description: Ireland: income while off sick for an employee working Monday to Friday: employer Statutory Sick Leave (5 days a year after 13 weeks' service, 70% of daily pay up to EUR110), Illness Benefit waiting days (SSL days count against the 3 waiting days; start day = max(SSL days, 3) + 1), then Illness Benefit (2026 rates by average weekly earnings; EUR264 maximum from January 2027), week by week.

sslEligible.description: 13 weeks or more with the employer (default true)

sslUsedThisYear.description: Statutory sick days already used this year (0-5)

weeks.description: Weeks off sick (illness starting on a Monday)
